## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.1

- Fixes the primary editor renderer so tree spines and horizontal connectors appear in Live Preview and Source mode.
- Fixes Reading-mode guide targeting for Obsidian's rendered Markdown container.
- Makes unordered-list marker visibility enabled by default in Style Settings.
- Adds optional Logseq-style list threading with a global switch and independent Live Preview, Source, and Reading-mode switches.
- Adds precise Style Settings controls for thread colors, opacity, thickness, caps, corner radius, connector geometry, and Reading-mode geometry.
- Keeps searchable settings, deterministic validation, the three standard Obsidian release assets, and GitHub artifact attestations.
